content: Prometrium® (progesterone, USP) is a brand of micronized progesterone capsules manufactured by Solvay Pharmaceuticals. It has received FDA approval for use in the United States. In January 1998, Solvay acquired the U.S. marketing rights for Prometrium® from Schering-Plough Corporation. The progesterone in Prometrium® is synthesized from yams and is chemically identical to the progesterone naturally produced in a woman’s body. The inactive ingredients in Prometrium® capsules include peanut oil NF, gelatin NF, glycerin USP, lecithin NF, titanium dioxide USP, and coloring agents. Prometrium® is prescribed as part of hormone replacement therapy, specifically bioidentical hormone replacement therapy. The micronization of progesterone significantly enhances its absorption when taken orally. Before the introduction of Prometrium®, micronized progesterone was only available through compounding pharmacies. However, its production as an FDA-approved prescription drug by a major pharmaceutical company has greatly improved its accessibility. Although Prometrium® capsules are most commonly administered orally, they are also available in the form of vaginal suppositories.
